node.title: Re^5: Formatting Regex for File::Find::Rule
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Thanks for putting up with me. I knew it was something stupid on my part.

No worries, glad to help! The [mod://File::Find::Rule] docs aren't 100% clear on that ->name matches the basename only, but I got my insights from peeking at the code - it's basically just compiling to a [mod://File::Find] routine, which you can see with the private method print $rule->_compile;, and there one can see it's matching against $_, and in [mod://File::Find] by default that's just the basename of the file, without the directory.
